newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI jumps 2.15 pct, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI jumps 2.15 pct, more gains seen.

text.p: Slovenia's blue-chip SBI index jumped 2.15 percent on Thursday, rising for the fifth day and traders said more was to come.

"Not only foreigners are buying -- there are also some speculators following them in expectation of more rises. The index will grow further but at a slightly slower pace," said Bojan Sekavcnik, a trader of brokerage BPH.
* The SBI index rose 32.82 points to 1,557.27.
* Port operator Luka Koper was the top gainer, jumping 9.20 percent to 2,100 tolars on volume of 3,432 shares.
* Mineral water producer and health resort operator Radenska was the most active, easing 0.21 percent to 1,890 tolars on volume of 9,115 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
